LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions, part of Strand 10 in Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do you join two or more sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify the conjunctions since, so, nor, yet, for, unless, although, though, in a text,

2. construct sentences on proper use of leisure time using conjunctions,

3. fill in blanks in sentences using conjunctions,

4. collaborate with peers to construct sentences using conjunctions,

5. create a crossword puzzle using conjunctions and share it with peers through posters, charts or social media.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify the conjunctions since, so, nor, yet, for, unless, although, though, in a text,
2. construct sentences on proper use of leisure time using conjunctions,
3. fill in blanks in sentences using conjunctions,
4. collaborate with peers to construct sentences using conjunctions,
5. create a crossword puzzle using conjunctions and share it with peers through posters, charts or social media.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Conjunctions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: The learner’s ability to focus on achieving the set tasks is enhanced as they identify and use

conjunctions in sentences.

• Digital Literacy: The learner’s ability to interact with technological devices is developed as they observe safety

precautions and share their crossword puzzles on various social media platforms.

Values:
Love: This is inculcated in the learner as they portray a caring attitude while collaborating with peers to construct

sentences using conjunctions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

• Life Skills (Effective Communication): The learner develops better communication skills through correct use of

• Life Skills (Decision making): The learner is equipped with decision making skills as they construct sentences on

proper use of leisure time using conjunctions.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of conjunctions to their learning of similar concepts in Kiswahili.
